title: Scheduler journal hotfix — bound SSE event reads, silence no-op fairness sweeps, decay no-progress wait loops (live-ops regression)
description: Live-ops fix for sustained CPU burn + dashboard latency observed on the deployed stack (events table 161k rows, ~1.2 cores idle). Three bounded changes. (1) MISSION_CONTROL eventsSince(sinceSeq, limit=1024) now delegates to new store.listEventsSince — SQL pushdown 'WHERE seq > ? ORDER BY seq LIMIT ?' with pageLimit/budget materialization, verifiedEvent per returned row preserved; latest_seq becomes high-water delivered (last returned seq, or sinceSeq when empty) so a truncated page lets SSE clients continue paging instead of skipping; hash verification on every returned row unchanged. (2) ObjectiveAutoScheduler.nextFairCandidate journals only durable DECISIONS: one FAIR_VISIT when a usable candidate is found (claim rotation position) or when a PAGE-full sweep must advance the cursor for progress, and FAIR_ROUND only when the cohort wrap/refresh changes durable state (last_visited_rank>0 or cohort_high_rank<registration_counter) — a no-change sweep over a parked cursor writes nothing since rescanning an unchanged cohort is deterministic; B06 cohort-refresh semantics preserved. (3) settle() adds wait_streak on WAKE_STATE: a timed-wait outcome (WAITING_EVIDENCE + non-null next_due) that leaves no pending generation is a proven-empty poll — consecutive ones scale next_due by min(2^streak,12) (300s baseline → ~1h ceiling); pending work arriving before settle or any non-timed-wait outcome resets the streak; the settled-lease retry_count semantics, fair cursor, lease fencing, policy authority re-proofs, COMMITTED/SETTLED adoption and all subscription/auth gates are unchanged. Evidence: 5 new hotfix tests failing-first pre-implementation (events paging/sha256-preserved, idle-sweep silence ≤1 commit, streak backoff 300s→600s→1200s→2400s→reset); adjacent suites p15-10b(+r1)/p15-10c(+r1-r4)/subscription-auto-run-ceo/p9 all green (236 tests).
